drug.description: Targets, mechanism and druggability for a single drug
drug.capability: Planned: target list with action type and the PubMed citation behind each finding (DrugBank targets, 10,009 covered), plus Lipinski rule-of-five from the JChem descriptors already in the database.

combination.description: Shared targets and overlapping mechanism across a drug set
combination.capability: Planned: common targets, target-profile overlap, and the drug-drug interaction pairs with their mechanism. Depends on the target data behind single-drug analysis.

structure.capability: Planned: Tanimoto similarity over Morgan fingerprints, Murcko scaffold clustering, and the kingdom-to-subclass classification tree. Fingerprints are not computed yet and must be generated from SMILES at import time.
